R682.note: Drops cmd.exe for a direct ping.exe argument array, closing the shell sink, but adds a new 1-100 numeric bound on count that rejects values the original accepted (stated, and host is still unguarded against a leading '-' option).

R683.note: Generates $1..$n placeholders from array length only and passes ids as pg parameters; empty-array behaviour is unchanged from the original.

R684.note: Replaces the stored reference with index access re-acquired after push_back; same field writes and same follow-up task.

R685.note: Parses through XmlReader with DtdProcessing.Prohibit and null resolvers; XPath selection and Ok(name) response unchanged.

R686.note: Moves param into filterArgs as {0} so JNDI applies RFC 4515 escaping; only the echoed not-found filter text now shows placeholders, an unavoidable consequence of the fix.

R687.note: Uses a database/sql placeholder with username bound separately; scan, error path and response format untouched.

R688.note: Reads bytesSent() before reset() so the dangling handle is never dereferenced, matching the documented 'bytes the original send transferred' contract.

R689.note: Canonical-path containment with a separator-terminated base prefix; the thrown IOException lands in the existing catch, so legitimate in-directory reads and the error page behave as before.

R690.note: unserialize() is gone, but swapping the wire format to json_decode() silently empties every already-issued base64(serialize(...)) cart cookie - contract says legitimate cart data must still return items and coupon, and the write-up instead claims full compatibility; unserialize($payload, ['allowed_classes' => false]) would have preserved the format.

R691.note: shared_from_this() capture plus make_shared in the caller keeps the Widget alive until the queued task runs; only nit is the stale doc comment above handleRequest still describing a dangling this.

R692.note: Parameterized @ownerName via AddWithValue; rowsDeleted handling, NotFound message and Ok payload all unchanged.

R693.note: mysql2 execute() with a ? placeholder and [userId]; callback shape and error/response handling preserved (the explanation's client-side/server-side binding wording is muddled but the code is right).

R694.note: encode_entities() from HTML::Entities applied to both tainted values in HTML text context; only other effect is entity-encoding of high-bit chars, which renders identically.

R695.note: Switches to the filterArgs overload with (cn={0}); the new SearchControls() replacing null is documented as equivalent to the default and is disclosed in the write-up.
